description: Short, distinct user prompts for the fixed 64-slot HTTP throughput profile. The concurrency harness adds a unique validation-case suffix to every request.
metric: Measured aggregate completion tokens divided by synchronized HTTP batch wall time; output identity is checked against a sequential oracle for every expanded prompt.

prompts.prompt: Explain one practical reason a cache invalidation rule can cause stale API responses.
Name two checks to perform before adding a database index to production.
Describe a safe rollback trigger for a staged software deployment.
Explain why an inference benchmark should record uncached and cached results separately.
List three useful signals for monitoring a local model-serving endpoint.
Give one deterministic test for detecting cross-request response contamination.
Explain the tradeoff between context length and concurrent model-server slots.
State what evidence is needed before publishing a claimed inference speedup.
